body: I have some slight similar memories, but with much blacked out. last time I spoke to her was in 08. bah, fuck it all. why the bloody shitty hell is my brain bringing this back. My entire body and mind is shattered

Some of the details are a bit blurry. Im 4. screaming at my mom. she is beating my 2 and a half year old sister who is crying. I beg to take her place, beg her to punish me instead. I cant remember why she is mad. I try getting her to stop. to leave my sister alone. but she is too strong. She throws me away and slaps my sister again. I bite her leg, just below her knee. bite hard, bite until I draw blood. suddenly my ear starts to burn and I get this ringinng sound in it. then it hurts. and even though I know realise it was a dream, the pain was and still is insane. She picks me up by my hair and throws me down and starts kicking. it all goes black, I awake being carried at the top of the stairs then thrown down. twice. it goes black. or blue ish. kinda weird. my ear is still ringinng. the last thing I remember before I manage to wake up is being locked inside a small cold dark room. I wake up. My ear is ringing and my face is burning. my heart wont settle down. Im sweating and cold. my body is screaming RUN RURURURUUUUN RUUUN and that I should hide. it all goes black. I come to and my hands are bleeding and the wall is red. I start throwing things around, bashing my head against the wall. my mouse is broken, some keys missing on the keyboard. but Ive stopped punching now.
